description: Score LEE1 CCCH fingers against the structurally defined TIS11d RNA-reading surface, weighted by observed RNA contacts in PDB 1RGO
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from collections import defaultdict
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
def fasta(a):
    L=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",headers=H,timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")
    return "".join(L[1:])
ACC={"LEE1":"Q02799","TIS11d":"P47974","TTP":"P26651","Cth2":"P47977","MKRN1":"Q9UHC7","ZC3H15":"Q8WU90","Nab2":"P32505"}
SEQ={k:fasta(v) for k,v in ACC.items()}

# ---- 1RGO contacts (recomputed, self-contained) ----
pdb=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1RGO.pdb",headers=H,timeout=120).text
lines=[];st=False
for ln in pdb.split("\n"):
    if ln.startswith("MODEL"):
        if st: break
        st=True; continue
    if ln.startswith("ENDMDL"): break
    if st and ln.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")): lines.append(ln)
at=[]
for ln in lines:
    nm=ln[12:16].strip(); rs=ln[17:20].strip(); el=(ln[76:78].strip() or nm[0])
    if el=="H" or nm.startswith("H"): continue
    at.append((int(ln[22:26]),rs,float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])))
A=pd.DataFrame(at,columns=["num","res","x","y","z"]); A["is_rna"]=A.res.isin({"U","A","G","C"})
P=A[(~A.is_rna)&(A.res!="ZN")]; R=A[A.is_rna]
D=np.sqrt(((P[["x","y","z"]].values[:,None,:]-R[["x","y","z"]].values[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1))
nc=defaultdict(int)
for i,j in zip(*np.where(D<4.0)): nc[P.iloc[i].num]+=1

def parse(seq,s1,lead=6):
    i=s1-1; m=re.match(r'C(.{4,15}?)C(.{3,8}?)C(.{3,4}?)H',seq[i:i+32]); a,b,c=m.groups()
    lab=['C1']+[f'C1+{k}' for k in range(1,len(a)+1)]+['C2']+[f'C2+{k}' for k in range(1,len(b)+1)]+['C3']+[f'C3+{k}' for k in range(1,len(c)+1)]+['H']
    res=list(range(s1,s1+len(lab))); ch=list(seq[i:i+len(lab)])
    for k in range(6,0,-1): lab.insert(0,f'C1-{k}'); res.insert(0,s1-k); ch.insert(0,seq[s1-k-1])
    return dict(map=dict(zip(lab,ch)),rmap=dict(zip(lab,res)),sp=(len(a),len(b),len(c)))

F={('TIS11d','ZF1'):parse(SEQ['TIS11d'],159),('TIS11d','ZF2'):parse(SEQ['TIS11d'],197),
   ('TTP','ZF1'):parse(SEQ['TTP'],109),('TTP','ZF2'):parse(SEQ['TTP'],147),
   ('Cth2','ZF1'):parse(SEQ['Cth2'],175),('Cth2','ZF2'):parse(SEQ['Cth2'],213),
   ('MKRN1','ZF1'):parse(SEQ['MKRN1'],61),('MKRN1','ZF2'):parse(SEQ['MKRN1'],90),
   ('ZC3H15','ZF1'):parse(SEQ['ZC3H15'],105),
   ('LEE1','ZF1'):parse(SEQ['LEE1'],93),('LEE1','ZF2'):parse(SEQ['LEE1'],124)}

POS=['C1-6','C1-5','C1-4','C1-3','C1-2','C1-1','C1','C1+1','C1+2','C2','C2+1','C2+2','C2+3','C2+4','C2+5','C3','C3+1','C3+2','C3+3','H']
# contact weight per anchor position = mean contacts over TIS11d ZF1 and ZF2
W={}
for p in POS:
    v=[]
    for f in ['ZF1','ZF2']:
        rn=F[('TIS11d',f)]['rmap'].get(p)
        v.append(nc.get(rn,0))
    W[p]=np.mean(v)
wser=pd.Series(W)
print("Contact weight per anchor position (mean of TIS11d ZF1/ZF2, # heavy-atom contacts <4A):")
print(wser[wser>0].sort_values(ascending=False).to_string())

# ---- build the matrix of residues ----
keys=[('TIS11d','ZF1'),('TIS11d','ZF2'),('TTP','ZF1'),('TTP','ZF2'),('Cth2','ZF1'),('Cth2','ZF2'),
      ('MKRN1','ZF1'),('MKRN1','ZF2'),('ZC3H15','ZF1'),('LEE1','ZF1'),('LEE1','ZF2')]
M=pd.DataFrame({f"{k[0]} {k[1]}":[F[k]['map'].get(p,'-') for p in POS] for k in keys},index=POS).T
print("\n=== Anchor-aligned CCCH finger residue matrix ===")
print(M.to_string())

# ---- chemical-class conservation score vs TIS11d, weighted by contact count ----
CLASS={**{a:'aromatic' for a in 'FYW'},**{a:'basic' for a in 'KR'},**{a:'acidic' for a in 'DE'},
       **{a:'polar' for a in 'STNQCH'},**{a:'hydrophobic' for a in 'AVLIMPG'}}
def score_row(name):
    tot=0; got=0; det=[]
    for p in POS:
        w=W[p]
        if w<=0: continue
        q=M.loc[name,p]
        # reference = the TIS11d finger with more contacts at that position
        refs=[F[('TIS11d','ZF1')]['map'].get(p),F[('TIS11d','ZF2')]['map'].get(p)]
        s=0.0
        if q in refs: s=1.0
        elif any(CLASS.get(q)==CLASS.get(r) for r in refs if r): s=0.5
        tot+=w; got+=w*s; det.append((p,q,"/".join([r for r in refs if r]),s,w))
    return got/tot, det

rows=[]
for name in M.index:
    sc,det=score_row(name)
    rows.append(dict(finger=name,contact_weighted_identity=round(sc,3),
                     spacing="C-x%d-C-x%d-C-x%d-H"%F[[k for k in keys if f"{k[0]} {k[1]}"==name][0]]['sp']))
SC=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\n=== Contact-weighted similarity to the TIS11d RNA-reading surface ===")
print(SC.to_string(index=False))
SC.to_csv('ccch_contact_weighted_scores.csv',index=False)
M.to_csv('ccch_anchor_alignment_matrix.csv')

# ---- figure ----
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(15,7.2),gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[1,4.2]},sharex=True)
ax=axes[0]
ax.bar(range(len(POS)),[W[p] for p in POS],color='#4c6ef5')
ax.set_ylabel("RNA contacts\n(mean, <4 A)")
ax.set_title("TIS11d (ZFP36L2) tandem CCCH fingers bound to UUAUUUAUU RNA (PDB 1RGO): RNA-reading positions,\nand what LEE1 (Q02799) has at each of them",fontsize=11)
ax2=axes[1]
ax2.set_xlim(-0.5,len(POS)-0.5); ax2.set_ylim(len(M.index)-0.5,-0.5)
for yi,name in enumerate(M.index):
    for xi,p in enumerate(POS):
        q=M.loc[name,p]
        refs=[F[('TIS11d','ZF1')]['map'].get(p),F[('TIS11d','ZF2')]['map'].get(p)]
        if W[p]>0:
            if q in refs: col='#2b8a3e'
            elif any(CLASS.get(q)==CLASS.get(r) for r in refs if r): col='#f59f00'
            else: col='#c92a2a'
        else: col='#868e96'
        if p in ('C1','C2','C3','H'): col='#1864ab'
        ax2.text(xi,yi,q,ha='center',va='center',fontsize=11,color=col,
                 fontweight='bold' if W[p]>=10 or p in ('C1','C2','C3','H') else 'normal')
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(M.index))); ax2.set_yticklabels(M.index,fontsize=10)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(POS))); ax2.set_xticklabels(POS,rotation=90,fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xlabel("anchor-relative position within the CCCH finger")
for sp in ax2.spines.values(): sp.set_visible(False)
ax2.tick_params(length=0)
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
ax2.legend(handles=[Line2D([],[],marker='s',ls='',color='#1864ab',label='Zn ligand'),
                    Line2D([],[],marker='s',ls='',color='#2b8a3e',label='identical to TIS11d at an RNA-contact position'),
                    Line2D([],[],marker='s',ls='',color='#f59f00',label='same chemical class'),
                    Line2D([],[],marker='s',ls='',color='#c92a2a',label='class changed'),
                    Line2D([],[],marker='s',ls='',color='#868e96',label='no RNA contact in 1RGO')],
           loc='lower center',bbox_to_anchor=(0.5,-0.55),ncol=5,fontsize=9,frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
